text:
maria: Customer escalation from Acme — charts in their dashboard started showing legend entries that flicker and reorder after our latest analytics ingest. They also report tooltips are blank on iPhone Safari. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/acme/flicker-001.png :grimacing:

support-bot: New ticket created #C-3342 and linked to this thread.

sam_oncall: looking. Is this only on mobile or desktop too?

maria: primary repro on mobile portrait 375px width (iPhone 12/13). Desktop looks mostly fine but legend ordering changed after midnight ingest — entries are not stable between refreshes.

eliot: I can repro locally with the sample dataset. Steps: 1) open dashboard, 2) enable "hourly ingest" flag, 3) refresh, 4) tap legend toggle. On mobile the legend items shuffle and tooltips show "—" (empty).

eliot: quick repro snippet (devtools emulation):
```js
// toggle sequence that triggers bug
document.querySelectorAll('.legend-item')[2].click();
await fetch('/api/analytics/refresh?since=1h');
// then legends re-render in new order without preserving dataset-key mapping
```

sam_oncall: any errors in console or server logs?

eliot: client console shows no exceptions. I see a WARN from ingest service at 1800454500: "ingest: schema-relaxation applied, label keys reordered" — could be related.

ingest-bot: deployed analytics-ingest v1.9.2 at 1800454500 to staging and prod (rolling). Release notes: "improve throughput by relaxing field ordering".

maria: Acme notes regression started ~1800455000 which matches deploy window.

sam_oncall: high-priority P0 until we verify data safety. If ingest is returning fields in arbitrary order and client code uses array index to map legend labels -> dataset values, that would explain reorder. We'll need a mitigation ASAP.

eliot: hypothesis: frontend relies on array index instead of stable key (metric_id). Quick fix: prefer stable id mapping in render layer. I can whip up a patch for the webshell and a targeted mobile CSS fix to avoid reflow.

maria: customer also saw tooltips empty — likely because tooltip lookup uses index too. Can we patch mobile to show raw metric name when tooltip missing?

sam_oncall: triage plan:
- rollback ingest v1.9.2 to v1.9.1 in prod (ops) — if deploy caused schema reordering.
- quick client-side patch to map legend by metric_id (eliot).
- provide Acme a rollback window and status updates.

eliot: I'll open a PR for the render mapping change and a small mobile guard to prevent layout shift when legend reorders. PR link (staging): https://github.com/redwood-inference/webshell/pull/4821

maria: Can ops confirm rollback ETA?

sam_oncall: pinging @ops to confirm; if rollback not possible quickly we can ship client hotfix behind a feature flag.

support-bot: Status update: customer notified of investigation.

eliot: repro notes for QA:
- Environment: iOS Safari emulation 13.0
- Dashboard: "token-usage" chart with 7 series.
- Before ingest: legend order matches metric list in sidebar. After ingest: order swaps, tooltip content becomes "—".
- Log lines: "ingest: reordered keys" present in server logs around 1800454500.

maria: adding customer contact — they asked for regular updates every 15m.

sam_oncall: assigning myself for coordination. Eliot, please mark PR as release-blocker. Ops, please advise rollback status or we flip feature flag.

eliot: noted. I'll attach unit tests to ensure legend render uses stable metric_id -> label mapping.

support-bot: Reminder: add postmortem tag when incident resolved. :memo:

maria: thanks team — keep thread updated, customer escalated to CSM.

sam_oncall: next message in 10m with ops status. :eyes:
